description_en: Refreshes the upload credential for a video file after the upload times out
description_zh: 用于视频文件上传超时后重新获取视频上传凭证
name: RefreshUploadVideo

parameters.help_en:
The audio or video ID. You can obtain the ID by using one of the following methods:
- For videos uploaded by using the console, log on to the [ApsaraVideo VOD console](https://vod.console.aliyun.com) and choose **Media Files** > **Audio/Video** to view the audio or video ID.
- If the audio or video is uploaded by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/55407.html operation, the audio or video ID is the value of the VideoId parameter in the response.
- After the audio or video is uploaded, you can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86044.html operation to query the audio or video ID, which is the value of the VideoId parameter in the response
parameters.help_zh:
音/视频ID。可通过以下方式获取：
- 通过控制台上传的视频，可登录[点播控制台](https://vod.console.aliyun.com)，选择**媒资库** > **音/视频**查看音频或视频ID。
- 通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/55407.html接口上传音频或视频时，音/视频ID为返回参数VideoId的值。
- 音频或视频上传后，可通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86044.html接口查询音/视频ID，为请求后返回参数VideoId的值
parameters.name: video_id

parameters.help_en: The custom ID. Only lowercase letters, uppercase letters, digits, hyphens, and underscores are supported. The value must be 6 to 64 characters in length and is unique at the user level
parameters.help_zh: 自定义 ID，仅支持小写字母、大写字母、数字、横线、下划线，长度 6-64 位。用户维度唯一
parameters.name: reference_id
